title: Professional Experience Data
description: Structured experience data for resume generation. This is the single source of truth — the resume builder agent will ONLY use claims documented here.

paths.description: User-configurable paths for resume tooling. Agents read these at runtime instead of hardcoding directories.

resumeDir.description: Directory containing source .docx resume files and where generated output is written (e.g., '~/workspace/resume')

version.description: Semantic version of this data file

lastUpdated.description: ISO date when this file was last modified

personalInfo.description: Contact and identity information. Placed in document body (not header/footer) for ATS compatibility.

summaryTemplates.description: Pre-written executive summary variations. The builder agent selects and tailors the most relevant one based on the target JD.

focus.description: What domain/role type this summary targets (e.g., 'frontend', 'full-stack', 'backend', 'leadership')

text.description: 3-4 sentence professional summary. Use {yearsExperience} as a placeholder for dynamic calculation.

skills.description: Skills grouped by category. Only include technologies used in the last 7-10 years unless a specific JD requests legacy tech.
List of skills in this category, ordered by proficiency/relevance

experience.description: Professional experience entries from 2016 to present. These get full treatment (4-6 bullets per role). Ordered most recent first.

additionalExperience.description: Pre-2016 roles. Condensed format — company, title, dates, and 0-2 bullets highlighting major wins only. Grouped under 'Previous Engineering Experience' on the resume.

startDate.description: Format: 'Month Year' (e.g., 'January 2022'). Always include month — AI flags missing dates.

bullets.description: Impact-driven accomplishments following X-Y-Z formula: Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z].

technologies.description: Technologies used in this role — used for keyword matching against JDs

text.description: The accomplishment statement. Should follow X-Y-Z formula where possible.

metrics.description: Quantified results (e.g., '40% performance improvement', '$120k annual savings', '5x deployment frequency'). Null if no metric available.

keywords.description: Key technologies, methods, or concepts in this bullet — used for JD keyword matching

category.description: What type of accomplishment this represents — helps the builder select relevant bullets for a given JD
